description: CrowdSec decision engine with an nftables bouncer and a Cloudflare Worker bouncer.
_doc: Drives the HOST firewall through the nftables bouncer, so it is not portable to a rootless or nested container runtime.

preUninstallExport.description: pg_dump of every database, a tarball per volume, host state, config and an EXPORT-MANIFEST.json. Runs BEFORE anything is removed; skipping takes a typed confirmation.

health.doc: Run from the module's directory in the installer checkout; exit 0 means healthy. Several modules have no HTTP surface to probe, and pulse's probe must assert the pinned build is the one running rather than merely that something answered.
